name: Saboteur

rounds.endCondition: After 3 rounds, the player with the most gold nuggets wins

categories.label: Gold nuggets won per round
categories.hint: Gold-Diggers win: each draws one gold card. Saboteurs win: each gets 3 nuggets (4 if only one Saboteur). Losers get 0.

tiebreakers.description: No official tiebreak found; tied players share the win

roles.label: Gold-Digger
roles.winCondition: A path card connects the start to a treasure card before cards run out

roles.label: Saboteur
roles.winCondition: Round ends with no path to the gold

notes: family: rounds-hidden-role. Gold card values: 16 x1, 8 x2, 4 x3 nuggets; Gold-Diggers draw gold cards individually, so enter the sum of nuggets per round. Optional Selfish Dwarf and tournament variants not modelled. Rulebook PDF could not be downloaded; verified against a secondary source only.
